name: n8n-prod
description: Production n8n holding the owner real workflows and mailbox credentials. Isolated stack, own Postgres, own tunnel.

managed_update.note: Enable only after the playground upgrade path is proven on this instance.

promotion.note: Repository and token are site-specific and come from the service .env: PROMOTION_REPOSITORY, PROMOTION_TOKEN. Give the token read access only; the branch protection is the control, not the token.
